sed -n '150,156p' lab/logs/app.log | python3 -c "
import sys, json
for line in sys.stdin:
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    try:
        d=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    print(d.get('ts'), d.get('event'), d.get('message'), d.get('request_id'))
"

grep -B2 '"exception_type": "ZeroDivisionError"' lab/logs/app.log | grep '"event": "request"\|"path"' | grep -o '"path": "[^"]*"' | sort | uniq -c
echo "---request lines right after ZeroDivisionError---"
awk '/"exception_type": "ZeroDivisionError"/{getline; print}' lab/logs/app.log | grep -o '"path": "[^"]*", "status": [0-9]*' | sort | uniq -c

python3 -c "
import re, yaml, json, jsonschema
text = open('journals/2026-08-18-order-500-null-price.md').read()
m = re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n', text, re.S)
fm = yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))

jsonschema.validate(fm, schema)
print('VALID')
print(json.dumps({k: fm[k] for k in ['verdict']}, indent=2))
"
